answer: Each epoch demands a fresh attestation from the issuer, and stale or copied records fail the check. The defence rests on metal detectorist licence: a licence the heritage body renews after reported finds. Forging 294 of these means fabricating 294 separate authority-backed records, and each one must survive a live registry check. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the atlas signal is public, the delta check is automatic, and 294 aliases cost 294 times what one real agent costs, with the dawn trail open to all.
